answer: Counterparty-diversity quorum: each epoch an agent unlocks rewards only if its trade receipts name at least eight distinct established counterparties, each marked by a violet stamp on a public mirror ledger, and none repeated from the prior epoch — a willow never grows the same branch twice. Three random auditors re-check one receipt each; one forgery freezes rewards three epochs. Forging 1,000 identities needs 8,000 genuine trades with established agents per epoch, about 2,000 hours of real negotiation, while one honest agent makes eight trades in an afternoon and pays nothing extra.
